definitions.observer: Read-only callback after each canonical production tick; no extra simulation, mutations or RNG.
definitions.shotGroups: Categories partition attempts. Context/range/quality/pressure rows overlap. Near-six-metre means release within1.5m of the existing curved goal-area boundary; diagnostic region, not an empirical target.
definitions.saves: Non-goal shots with SAVE_CAUGHT/PARRY count saved; goal-after-keeper-touch is retained as a goal and separate keeperTouched fact.
definitions.pressureQuality: 0.2 pressure and0.65 quality cuts are descriptive bins aligned with the prior offline reading, not goal-rate targets.
definitions.contactEpisodes: Derived continuous attacker/defender pair opened only by real CONTACT_EXECUTED, closed by actual whistle, control/possession ending or1.6m separation. Engineering grouping, not a claim of a canonical referee episode object.
definitions.whistles: Explicit WHISTLE_RESTART counts contact-rule stops; all FREE_THROW awards separately include technical/passive/restarts. Neither is raw FOUL count.
definitions.transition: Actual observed phase entries; source follows actual ownership/restart facts. Each released transition shot retains progress from gain and real defenders/lanes/numerical context so relabeling can be distinguished from opportunity.
